summary: Narwhals implementation of the relation system, serving pandas, PyArrow, cuDF and lazy-frame inputs through the Narwhals adapter. Composes the same eight Substrait mixins and Mountainash extension mixin as other backends into NarwhalsRelationSystem.
key_classes: NarwhalsRelationSystem — registered (NARWHALS) relation system composing the base mixin, eight Substrait-aligned mixins (read, project, filter, sort, fetch, join, aggregate, set) and the Mountainash extension mixin by multiple inheritance
NarwhalsBaseRelationSystem — identifies the backend, supplies export/import_into/check_import and name-inference hooks
key_functions: register_relation_system(CONST_BACKEND.NARWHALS) — decorator in the package __init__ registering the composed class
declare_lowering(method[, LoweringDescriptor]) — module-level loop declaring every lowering method reusable; pivot declared REPEATABLE with materializes_input=True
extension_points: Subclass/compose a Substrait*/Mountainash* mixin and add it to the composed class bases
BaseRelationSystem hooks: infer_row_index_names, infer_cross_join_names, export, import_into, check_import, native_scan_eligible
lifecycle_notes: Latest change: 08ac43e6 feat(resources): confine native and fallback resource reads; decision-7 allow-list (381)
3b4cc887 lazy check_import payload so non-SQLite destinations never export
documentation_hooks: Backend implementation guide: adding a relation operation to a backend
Execution locations and Arrow import/export boundary
examples: Dispatched via the relation visitor: ma.relation(df).filter(...).collect() routes to the registered system for the frame's backend
risks: Wraps pandas, PyArrow, cuDF and lazy frames via Narwhals; behaviour differs between eager and lazy dialects (narwhals-lazy, narwhals-pandas, narwhals-dask ...)
Row-level semantics follow the Narwhals subset, so some ops rely on workarounds (see known-divergences)
